description: Validate and decode a Brazilian boleto: digitable line (47 cobranca / 48 arrecadacao) or barcode (44). Returns bank, amount, due date (flags ambiguity from the Febraban 2025 factor reset) and check-digit results. Price: $0.005.

code.description: Digitable line or barcode, with or without punctuation.
